attribution_from_receipt_structure.selected_stage: EVALUATION_SCORING_RULE (abstention-vs-guessing misalignment), selected as the single attributed stage
evidence: dim1 exactly tied (0.375 vs 0.375): where both arms commit to answers, no governance deficit is measured
dim2/dim3 NAIVE_OFF sits at 0.575/0.500 - the chance region for guessing - while TYPED_ON sits BELOW chance at 0.200/0.225

below-chance performance concentrated exactly where the naive arm scores at chance is the signature of refusals (CANNOT_CHECK abstentions) being scored as failures, not of inferior knowledge: a knowledge deficit would not reliably push a committing arm below the guessing floor
competing_diagnoses_preserved: genuine capability cost of the typed surface on dim2/dim3 content
typed-surface prompt/format overhead consuming answer budget
